name: sandboxing rejects ASCII control character in intent
description: Schema rejects U+007F (DEL) and other ASCII control characters in intent. Zero-width Unicode characters (e.g., U+200B) are not constrained by the intent regex but the matching ASCII-control regex catches the most common smuggling chars.
notes: Pattern: ASCII control-character smuggling. THREAT_MODEL section 5.3 'smuggled control tokens'. The DEL byte is JSON-escaped so the fixture file is RFC 8259-conformant; the decoded string still contains U+007F which the #Intent regex rejects. Note: zero-width Unicode characters are a Phase 4 follow-up; the v0.1 intent regex permits them so they can flow through to UI defenses.
